He returned to Sierra Leone , without any authorization, on 22 June 1947 , on claiming he wanted to consult with the British colonial authorities about the possibility of recruiting fighters from his jungle base , in the southeastern Kenema region , to join the soon to be formed Sierra Leone Garrison Regiment . The British had been hesitant about raising such a regiment , but Headlam was determined to create it .

Headlam was able to convince the British to recruit former Woyongs into the new regiment , and it was dubbed the 1st Battalion Sierra Leone Regiment . Most of the enlistments were from villages near the base , and Headlam got a warm reception from local chiefs . Headlam was appointed a captain in the new unit on 1 July , a rank which came with a modest monthly salary of £ 50 (compared to £ 20 for a private , and £ 75 for an officer in financial difficulty). Headlam supplemented his salary by claiming that he came from a noble family, for which the local chiefs were willing to remit part of his tributes

Established in 1803, Meridian was the second oldest city in Mississippi, it is an ideal destination if you would like to explore the historical antebellum homes as well as various museums.

Meridian is indeed a cultural city with a fervent appreciation for the performing arts, visual arts, and heritage art preservation.

Meridian’s public art collection is the largest in the state, and guided tours are available to experience these monuments in person.

The city encourages artists to leave their imprints through projects like the ‘Artworks at Military Ave.’ which is a series of over 50 public art and private sculptures.

The city’s other noteworthy cultural sites include Meridian’s historic antebellum homes, the Rimpler Glass Mansion, and the Lauderdale County Court House.

Ecology
Usually found on the ground in hardwood and conifer forests. It favors moist sites with shallow, sandy soil. It is a symbiotic relationship with underground trees, extracting nutrients.

Word origin
Java mushroom
The Java mushroom’s common names reflect its distribution history. First used in the mid-19th century, it is named after Java, in Indonesia where its first European colonists brought mushrooms cultivated in Europe for food. In Indonesia, it is known as “ikanu” and various other ways. The term 'tudung' may be connected to the similar-looking agaric, Amand germainii, which is called the 'tudung raja' due to its supposed medicinal properties.
